name: Takasugi Shinsaku
source:
"There are things I cant understand unless I do them with my own hands."
After his master died he became a warrior of the anti-western Choushuu.
A charismatic guy, the leader of the irregular militia forces.
He's a bit awkward but he has a kind and childish side.
